{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display basic info
print(sales_df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(sales_df.head())

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values per column:')
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique channels
print('\nUnique marketing channels:')
print(sales_df['channel'].unique())

# Check revenue column
print('\nRevenue column dtype:')
print(sales_df['revenue'].dtype)

# Check for negative or zero revenue
print('\nRevenue summary:')
print(sales_df['revenue'].describe())"}
